providerQuery._source: docs/tech/F02-map-location-spike.md section 3 (query loc, trace, speed, loop, hud; ค่าเริ่มต้นต่อ environment มาจาก client config; ค่าที่ไม่รู้จัก → ใช้ค่าเริ่มต้นและเตือนใน console)
providerQuery._note: capacitor is selectable but the stub reports not-implemented (tests the error path). traceWhenUnset: first trace of the import.meta.glob list (gps-trace-format section 5) that passes validateTrace. Boolean params use '1'/'0' in the URL. `start`, `seed`, `e2eClassId` and `e2eSkipF04App` (F04-dungeon-presence.md section 17 test hooks, tech gate P2-F05-T15 decision 6.2) are read only when `loc=mock`: `start` sets the game clock's replay-start instant (integer epoch ms, or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` interpreted with `config/balance/dungeons.json#openingHours.utcOffset_min`, read via config/balance.ts); `seed` sets the uint32 RNG `runSeed` for every run started on that page load; `e2eClassId` dispatches a real `chooseClass` input once at boot for a spec that skips the (not yet built) class-picker screen; `e2eSkipF04App` skips creating the whole F04 game loop for a map-only spec. All four are silently ignored outside `loc=mock` (Web always uses the real clock and `crypto.getRandomValues`, ADR 0003 section 6) — see `apps/client/src/f04-app.ts`'s `resolveRunSeed`/`resolveE2eClassId` and `apps/client/src/env.ts`'s `shouldSkipF04App`, each gated on the selected provider, not a build-time flag

toast._source: P2-F05-T10 (design/ux/flows/F05-movement-gate-reward.md Flow A1/A2/A3: 'หายเองสั้นๆ' / 'toast จาง' — the flow never gives an exact on-screen hold duration or icon cap, only the effect/sound durations already in audio/manifest.json and art/vfx/*/timing.json). P2-F06-T08 added hpLowHoldDurationMs (design/ux/flows/F06-hp-damage-onboarding.md Flow C2 'run.hpLow' canon toast).
toast._note: apps/client/src/ui/tick-toast.ts: tickHoldDurationMs is how long a granted/denied tick toast stays fully visible (after its own vfx enter animation, before the shared exitToast animation starts) — long enough to read a short Thai sentence at a glance per the flow's own 'อ่านจบได้ในแวบเดียว' rule without outlasting the next tick window. tickMaxIconsShown is flow F05 A1's literal cap ('ไม่เกิน 3 ชิ้นที่เห็นพร้อมกัน ที่เหลือดูในสรุป run'). hpLowHoldDurationMs is the same 'stays fully visible before exit' hold, just for `run.hpLow`'s own, much longer canon sentence ('HP ต่ำ กลับบ้าน ซื้อยา หาเพื่อนที่มี Support หรือไม่ก็เลิกดื้อ', a full clause list vs a tick toast's few words) — its own key rather than reusing tickHoldDurationMs so the two can be tuned independently.
toast._assumption: A-P2-F05-T10-1: 2200 ms is not tuned against a real device/field-walk pass yet (same caveat as A-P2-F04-T21-1); tickMaxIconsShown 3 matches the flow doc's own number exactly, not an assumption. Owner: gameplay-programmer, revisit tickHoldDurationMs with P2-C03/P2-F06-T12 field evidence. A-P2-F06-T08-2: hpLowHoldDurationMs 4000 ms is a proportional scale-up of tickHoldDurationMs (about 1.8x, roughly matching the ratio of sentence lengths) — not tuned against a real device/field-walk pass yet either. Owner: gameplay-programmer, revisit with P2-F06-T12/field evidence.

bundle._source: ADR 0003 section 10 (N-13): JS-transfer budgets measured from apps/client/dist's Vite manifest by apps/client/scripts/measure-bundle.ts, brotli quality 11, same method for both keys.
bundle._note: initialJsBudget_bytes covers the entry chunk + every chunk it statically imports (S5 <= 1.0 MB, 10^6 byte) — never maplibre-gl, which main.ts only reaches through await import(...) once hasRuntimeMapEnv(env) is true (P2-F04-T10 code-split). mapLazyJsBudget_bytes covers that lazy maplibre-gl + worker chunk group on its own, measured the same way. CSS/font/tile/trace bytes are excluded from both (ADR 0003 10.4). CI (P2-F06-T16) fails the build when either is exceeded.
bundle._assumption: A-P2-F04-T10-2: this task's own `pnpm build` + `apps/client/scripts/measure-bundle.ts` measured the entry chunk (post code-split) at 48,303 B brotli and the maplibre-gl + worker lazy group at 350,208 B brotli. initialJsBudget_bytes keeps the S5 <= 1.0 MB ceiling from ADR 0003 unchanged (measured value is well under it already); mapLazyJsBudget_bytes is set to 700,000 B (about 2x the measured 350,208 B) for headroom before P2-F06 adds more map layers/assets, not tuned against a real device yet (revisit once P2-C03's real-device numbers land). Owner: gameplay-programmer, tech-lead

requestOrigins._source: config/app/privacy.json#externalNavigation _note ("outside the allowed-origin list of config/app/client.json"); docs/tech/F04-dungeon-presence.md section 14.1 ("e2e ตรวจ origin (C2-1, P2-F04-T22)"); qa/plans/F04-test-plan.md section 6 (C2-1); filled by P2-F06-T08 after P2-F04-T25 missed it (A-P2-F04-T22-2, qa/tests/e2e/f04-origin-allowlist.spec.ts)
requestOrigins._note: Every request/fetch/XHR/WebSocket the app itself may issue must stay within this list. 'self' means the page's own origin. Phase 2 has no server (D-087): telemetry stays in localStorage/memory only, so this list has exactly one entry and is expected to stay that way until a real backend origin exists (Phase 3). The external navigation deep link (Google/Apple Maps, config/app/privacy.json#externalNavigation) is a top-level <a target="_blank"> page navigation the player taps themselves, not a fetch/XHR of the app, and stays explicitly outside this list (tech note F04 14.1) — qa's e2e checks this directly by capturing page.on('request') during a full run rather than reading this key back, so no apps/client/src module parses this list yet; it exists to give the two doc references above (and any future automated diff) a real, single-source value instead of an undocumented gap.
requestOrigins._assumption: A-P2-F06-T08-1: no spec/tech note pins an exact key name or shape for this list (P2-F04-T25's own acceptance only said "a list of allowed origins in config/app/client.json (C2-1)" without one) — one entry, 'self', matches D-087 (Phase 2 issues no request to any other origin) exactly and needs no client.schema.json change (the schema has no additionalProperties: false at any level, confirmed before adding this key). Owner: tech-lead to confirm the shape if a future task starts parsing it programmatically.
